1. (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, wherein the non-native compartment is not derived from a naturally occurring bacterial microcompartment.

2. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo and is not identical to any naturally occurring bacterial microcompartment.

3. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme that is not found in a naturally occurring bacterial microcompartment.

4. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes that are not found in a naturally occurring bacterial microcompartment.

5. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 4 wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence that is not found in a naturally occurring bacterial microcompartment.

8. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides that are not derived from a single naturally occurring bacterial species.

11. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein at least one BMC polypeptide comprises an affinity tag that is not found in a naturally occurring bacterial microcompartment.

12. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide that is not found in a naturally occurring bacterial microcompartment, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide.

21. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide that is not derived from a naturally occurring bacterial microcompartment, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product that is not produced by a naturally occurring bacterial microcompartment. 

28. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 comprising a plurality of compartments that are not derived from naturally occurring bacterial microcompartments.
